title: subapp-host
description: The one object a host app hands every mounted sub-app (Stratum, Cadence, the wiki), through the package's own data provider: `<DataClientProvider host>` (@smartmemory/stratum-ui, @cadence/ui) and `<WikiDataProvider host>` (@wiki/components); each package reads it with `useHost()`, null when it runs standalone. Three parts: what the user has selected, how the rooms are authenticated, and where they publish attention rows. Compose builds it in one place (`src/components/cockpit/subappHost.js` `buildSubappHost`). No workspace field: COMP-SUBAPP-HOST-WORKSPACE-1 (row 306b) adds it.

attention.description: The attention sink: a function `(source, rows) => void`. `source` names the publisher (`stratum`, `compose-gates`, ...); `rows` is that publisher's whole current list of inbox rows (each `#/definitions/inboxRow`) and replaces its last one, so an empty list clears it. JSON Schema has no function type: a validator sees a function as no JSON type at all, which is what `not` below checks (data of any JSON type is refused). Row 307 (COMP-SUBAPP-ATTENTION-1) wires publishers and the inbox to it.

selection.description: What the user has selected in the host. Every field optional; an empty object means nothing is selected and every room shows everything. Rooms filter by the fields they understand: Stratum runs by `featureCode`; the Cadence belt by `unit` and `lane` only (the host sends Cadence no `featureCode`, because belt unit ids are not feature codes, and sends the lane mapped to its ops lane; COMP-SUBAPP-HOST-1-FU-1); the wiki opens `featureCode`'s hub.

featureCode.description: The selected roadmap feature (Compose: the selected item's feature code, else the explicitly focused feature).

lane.description: The selected fleet lane (Compose: the open project graph's lane).

unit.description: The selected Cadence unit id. No Compose surface selects one yet; a host that does sets it.

auth.description: What the rooms need to call their data client: nothing they hold themselves. Every call goes through the DataClient the host built, which carries the credential: Compose's three clients (`src/lib/clients/{stratum,cadence,wiki}.js`) send through `wsFetch`, which adds `x-compose-token` in `cockpit` mode and a fresh `Authorization: Bearer` access JWT in `mobile-paired` mode; the wiki's own token never leaves Compose's `/api/wiki` proxy. So this carries no token, only the mode, for a room that wants to say which it is under.

credentials.description: Where the credential lives: in the host's DataClient, never in the room.

inboxRow.description: One row of the cockpit inbox, the type every source adapter in `src/components/cockpit/notify/notifyLogic.js` produces (header: `{key, kind, severity, title, detail, since, sourceLabel, action}`; e.g. `attentionAdapter`). Extra fields an adapter adds (`seat`, `lane`, `wall`) are allowed.

key.description: Stable id; the notify state clears and answers rows by it.

since.description: Age in seconds, null when unknown.

sourceLabel.description: The source's name in the tray (`cadence attention`).

action.description: The cockpit view a click opens (`cadence`, `fleet`, `inbox`).
